newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee gains on poor dlr demand, fresh supply.
newsitem.headline: India rupee gains on poor dlr demand, fresh supply.

text.p: The Indian rupee gained against the dollar on Wednesday on the back of lack of buying support and good dollar supply, dealers said.
The rupee opened the day nearly unchanged at 35.72/74 per dollar but immediately rose to 35.70/71 level in early inter-bank trade, dealers said.
The dollar soon crossed the 35.70 rupee mark, something no dealer could have visualised earlier this month when persistent dollar demand drove the rupee to a low of 35.84.
